name: Echo DCS-5000
blurb: Battery saw. Echo's chart: 18″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links (91PX62CQ).
intro: The DCS-5000 is a battery saw. Echo's Bars and Chains chart lists one row: bar 18A0CD3762C, 62 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile, chain 91PX62CQ, 5/32″ file. Echo also lists a 3-pack, 91PX62CQ-3, for that loop. The catalog does not print a displacement for the DCS-5000.

bars.note: Echo bar 18A0CD3762C; chain 91PX62CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. Echo's chart also lists 3-pack 91PX62CQ-3 for this loop.
